extension.description: Unofficial Kodi Amazon Music Add-on - Kodi extention to browse and play Amazon Music songs. An Amazon account is necessary. Inputstream Adaptiv needs to be activated and the latest widevine verion installed.
extension.disclaimer: Some parts of this addon may not be legal in your country of residence - please check with your local laws before installing. All used images are from Amazon.
extension.news: v2.3.0 - Back in spacy's repository, with the versions 2.0.0 to 2.2.3 by Kai Sommerfeld taken over. You have to sign in once more. - The requests follow the current web player of Amazon Music. - New: Songs you own are asked for as the web player does and come without DRM, on every platform. - New: After Amazon refused the DRM licence for a missing Verified Media Path, the next song is asked for as an unverified client, as the web player does. Not tried on a real account yet. - New: Search, recommendations, charts, new releases, playlists, genres and radio stations come from the GraphQL interface of the current web player. - Fixed: Sign-in: when Amazon asks for a code sent by SMS, a dialog with OK (enter the code), Resend code and Verify with WhatsApp is shown.
